avatar.name: The Quietly Thinning Thirties Man
avatar.description: Men 30–42 who notice a wider part, temple recession, or crown thinning in bathroom lighting. Still early enough to hope it's stress or a bad cut, late enough that photos and meetings make avoidance a habit. Competes silently with younger coworkers and with the version of himself from five years ago.
avatar.awareness_notes: Mix of problem-aware (notices shed in drain) and solution-aware (tried minoxidil/oils/gummies); some product-aware and skeptical after weak results.

pain_points.description: Harsh bathroom light makes thinning undeniable; he starts avoiding angles and flash photos.
examples: I delete half my photos before anyone sees them.
pain_points.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE

pain_points.description: Hair was part of how he looked 'put together'; thinning feels like aging overnight.

product_fit.mechanism: Alcohol-free leave-in serum with measured dropper dosing aimed at reducing DHT activity at the follicle while staying wearable in a daily routine without grease theater.
product_fit.how_it_resolves: Gives a mechanism-level story beyond vitamins/oils, with a controllable daily ritual that targets the hormonal driver men already halfway believe after research.
product_fit.label: PLAUSIBLE_INFERENCE
